gloss: how filling food is; staying power of food

definitions.gloss: how filling food is; how long food keeps you full
definitions.explanation: The quality of food in terms of how long it keeps you feeling full after eating. Almost always used with がいい (filling, keeps you full) or がわるい (not filling, wears off quickly).

examples.japanese: ⟦おにぎり→おにぎり：04956_onigiri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{腹持|はらも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{腹持|はらも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{空|す}く。
examples.english: Bread isn't very filling, so I get hungry again quickly.
It's better to eat something filling for breakfast.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧ (stomach) + ⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (lasting/holding). Describes how long food keeps you feeling full. There is no single English equivalent — the closest terms are "filling" or "satisfying."

FIXED PATTERNS:
- {腹持|はらも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: filling, keeps you full a long time
- {腹持|はらも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: not filling, wears off quickly
- {腹持|はらも}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧: filling food

FOODS OFTEN DESCRIBED THIS WAY:
- ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧ / ごはん: rice — generally considered {腹持|はらも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧
- ⟦おにぎり→おにぎり：04956_onigiri⟧: rice balls — filling
- ⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧: bread — often considered {腹持|はらも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧
- おかゆ / ⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧: porridge/soup — not very filling

THE ～{持|も}ち PATTERN:
The suffix ～⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ means "how well something lasts":
- ⟦{日持|ひも}ち→日持ち：12886_himochi⟧: shelf life (of food)
- {色持|いろも}ち: color retention
